text_block_list.text:
During some free time, I came to check out 
a trending game. It's a battle royale 
supporting massive team battles, with 
crafting elements like trap-making driving 
its popularity.

Perhaps because it can be played on the VR 
Umalator, several Tracen horse girls could 
be seen scattered around the game's lobby.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh! You're on my team! Look forward to 
seeing the "Emperor" in action!
choice_data_list: Glad to have you on board.
Looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, on the opposing team, familiar 
faces appeared—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaa~~ Teio is on the enemy team!! This 
is gonna be an absolute scorcher of a 
battle!! Let's join forces and do our 
best, BNW~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: So damn suffocating...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well, let her be. Since it's a team 
battle... let us counter them with 
coordinated teamwork.

The match began, teleporting players 
across the field. The team camera allowed 
viewing allies' battles, so I decided to 
check in—

text_block_list.name: Generic Player
text_block_list.text: Aargh, I-I'm done for! S-So strong...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe~! That makes thirty! Now then, 
let's check the log!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? In overall score, our team is 
actually losing?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, doesn't matter! If I just take out 
the entire opposing team all by myself, we 
win anyway—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, next target spotted~! Surrender 
quietly and let me defeat you~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Kh, I've been spotted. I must make a 
tactical retreat for now—!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, as expected, she won't let me escape 
so easily...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait up, wait up~! I'm not letting you get 
away~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Just kidding! Running away with zero 
intent to fight is way too suspicious, 
even for you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Obstructed terrain with poor visibility... 
If it were me, I'd totally lay a trap 
ahead! Plus, she's definitely coordinating 
with Ticket and Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nishi-shi... Knowing that! I'm gonna turn 
the tables and ambush them instead!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
She's not pursuing. Did she see right 
through us?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, how unexpected. For the "Genius 
Teio"... I anticipated she would see 
through the trap yet dive in, breaking 
through with sheer brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
For instance, the "Emperor" Rudolf... 
would pay no heed to petty traps and 
overpower her opponents head-on with regal 
dignity.

text_block_list.name: Admiring Spectators
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing! No tactic can stand against 
her...! As expected of the "Emperor" who 
surpasses the "Emperor"...!

text_block_list.name: Bowing Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Races, games, the Emperor of every realm 
is none other than this supreme ruler...! 
We bow before you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I know full well it's a 
trap... but that doesn't matter to me! 
Because I am the invincible "Emperor"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I'll show you what a true Emperor looks 
like! Let's settle this!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Heh... I believed you would take the bait. 
Here we go, Taishin, Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Taishin & Ticket
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

Tokai Teio gracefully evaded the barrage 
of traps and backed BNW into a corner, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
—Aaargh! We were so close~! If I only had 
a sliver more HP left, I could've gotten 
Taishin too...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
That was insanely close!! You took down me 
and Hayahide! And held out alone under 
total disadvantage... Waaaaahhh! That was 
so moving, I'm crying!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...And your personal score blew everyone 
else out of the water anyway, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Still though~... Falling for that bait was 
definitely a mistake. Guess I 
underestimated the teamwork of you 
three...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Aaargh! So frustrating! Next time, I'm 
definitely, totally gonna win!
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's show them the true power 
of the Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Aaargh! So frustrating! Next time, I'm 
definitely, totally gonna win!
choice_data_list:
Next time, let's show them the true power 
of the Emperor!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...I just had a great idea! Next round, 
let's do me vs. everyone else!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I won't make any misjudgments this time! 
I'll show you the real deal—the absolute 
power of the Emperor!

A reckless proposal that left even BNW 
exasperated... Yet with Tokai Teio, one 
couldn't help but feel she just might pull 
it off.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However... individual skill remains a 
vital element. What do you say? Why not 
fight on the same team once and learn from 
each other's strengths?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Really? Count me in, count me in! I'll 
master all your strong points in no time 
flat!

Teaming Tokai Teio with BNW made them 
unstoppable. In the subsequent games, the 
four of them put on a spectacular show.
